Download **Halo.zip**, unzip it and drag **Halo.app** into **Applications**, then open it
from there.

Halo isn't notarized by Apple, so the first time you open it macOS will say it can't
verify the developer. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down and click
**Open Anyway**. Then follow the Guide that opens: allow Accessibility, and sign in to
[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) for the Claude actions. Everything else works
without it.

**Updating?** Quit Halo, replace Halo.app with the new one, then turn Halo off and on again in
Privacy & Security > Accessibility, since macOS treats each build as a new app. To pick up
rings added since your version, open Settings > Apps and click **Restore Presets**. From
1.0.3 on, Halo's menu tells you when there's a new version.

More at [nakulpatel0306.github.io/halo](https://nakulpatel0306.github.io/halo/).
